## Overview {#overview}

Before the lantern, a fire on the cliff served the same purpose.

The lantern keeps its flame behind thin glass so the wind cannot reach it.

A keeper trims the wick each evening before the fishing boats come home.

## Fuel {#fuel}

Animal fats were the first fuels used in early towers.

## Keepers {#keepers}

Kerosene replaced it after 1860 because it was cheaper to refine.

The last keeper left the island in 1962.

The light still turns every night, a single horizontal beam.
